note: Machine-readable side of docs/genome/LICENCES.md. Software licences and data/service terms are recorded separately. Nothing here is a legal conclusion. 'commercialPilot' is 'approved' only after a named person has reviewed the current terms; until then every item is 'not-approved', and tools running in commercial-pilot mode refuse to use it. 'permissions' splits app use into separate decisions (fetch, store, display, redistribute) for research and demo use; only 'allowed' permits an action, and anything else, or a missing entry, denies it. 'clinicalUse' is 'not-approved' for every item: no clinical use is approved, and clinical use also needs the release gate in config/genome/governance/release-gate.json.

items.name: Ensembl REST API (gene, transcript, sequence)
items.supplies: Gene coordinates (GRCh38), canonical transcript and exons, coding and genomic sequence, release number.
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: only the public REST service is called; no Ensembl code is bundled.
items.dataTerms: Read from the authoritative pages on 2026-10-27 (licence-terms run 40534185586 (2026-10-27); page hashes in docs/genome/terms-check.json). Ensembl disclaimer (served from jun2026.archive.ensembl.org after a redirect): 'Ensembl imposes no restrictions on access to, or use of, the data provided'; 'Ensembl data generated by members of the project are available without restriction'; Ensembl code is under Apache 2.0; the page also states that some data may be subject to third-party constraints. EMBL-EBI terms of use: EMBL-EBI 'places no additional restrictions on the use or redistribution of the data ... other than those provided by the original data owners'; 'The original data may be subject to rights claimed by third parties'; it 'expects attribution'; resource-specific terms prevail where they exist.
items.attribution: EMBL-EBI expects attribution 'in publications, services or products'; confirm the wording Ensembl asks for.
items.redistribution: Raw responses are kept in data/genome/snapshot/ and are not served. The website serves a display-only copy (public/vision/display/): the fields the app shows. Confirm whether serving even that copy is permitted, and with what attribution.
items.followUp: A named reviewer to confirm that no third-party-constrained Ensembl data is used, and that the redirect to the archive site does not change the terms; record the approval or restriction here.

permissions.basis: Research and demo use only. Fetch, store and display rest on the product owner's app-use decision (appUse: not-restricted, 2026-10-27); the terms review itself is still terms-read-pending-review. Redistribution is not permitted until a named reviewer confirms the provider's terms allow it.

items.name: NCBI ClinVar via E-utilities (esearch, esummary)
items.version: No release number in the response; snapshot retrieved 2026-10-20
items.supplies: Submitted variant records for a gene: HGVS, classification, review status, conditions, GRCh38 location.
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: only the public E-utilities service is called.
items.dataTerms: NCBI policies page read on 2026-10-27 (licence-terms runs 40534185586 and 40534934746; page hashes in docs/genome/terms-check.json). Government-created information 'is within the public domain' and NLM asks to be acknowledged. For the molecular databases: 'NCBI itself places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data contained therein. Nor do we accept data when the submitter has requested restrictions on reuse or redistribution. However, some submitters of the original data ... may claim patent, copyright, or other intellectual property rights in all or a portion of the data ... NCBI cannot provide comment or unrestricted permission concerning the use, copying, or distribution of the information contained in the molecular databases.' Also: 'All persons reproducing, redistributing, or making commercial use of this information are expected to adhere to the terms and conditions asserted by the copyright holder', and 'NCBI's Disclaimer and Copyright notice must be evident to users of your service.' The E-utilities guidelines and ClinVar 'maintenance and use' pages were fetched but no licence text could be extracted.
items.attribution: NLM requests acknowledgment; NCBI's disclaimer and copyright notice must be evident to users of a service built on it.
items.redistribution: Not stored, served or displayed. The captured raw batches were removed from the working tree on 2026-10-29 (listed with their digests in data/genome/snapshot/rpe65/REDACTIONS.json); earlier commits still contain them. Legal review is required for reuse, redistribution and that history.
items.followUp: Legal review of reuse and redistribution of submitter content (required). Display NCBI's disclaimer and copyright notice wherever ClinVar data is shown; NCBI data use stays blocked for the app until then. Confirm E-utilities rate limits and the tool/email parameters.
items.appUseCondition: Blocked for the app (product owner, 2026-10-27) until NCBI's required disclaimer and copyright notice are displayed to users. NCBI's policies state that its Disclaimer and Copyright notice must be evident to users of a service built on its data. ClinVar reuse also requires legal review.

permissions.basis: App use blocked by the product owner, 2026-10-27, until NCBI's required disclaimer and copyright notice are displayed; reuse and redistribution of submitter content require legal review. Every action is denied.
